_comment: Critic Feedback Test 4: Cleanup — Verifica que el feedback_key se limpia del state cuando la tarea es resuelta manualmente (accept / skip / cancel / retry tras max_retries). Igual que Test 2 pero con max_retries=2 para forzar la suspensión rápidamente.
_test_instructions: PASO 1 — Ejecutar hasta max_retries (critic rechaza 2 veces, suspende con elección):
cargo run --bin dag_engine -- run tests/graphs/advanced/critic_feedback_cleanup_test.json
ESPERADO: DAG suspende ofreciendo opciones: accept / skip / retry / cancel
OPCION A — Accept (aprobar el resultado actual tal como está):
cargo run --bin dag_engine -- run tests/graphs/advanced/critic_feedback_cleanup_test.json \
--session-id <ID> --answer 'accept'
VERIFICAR: el grafo termina con FINISHED. El feedback_key fue limpiado del state.
En los prompts de tareas subsiguientes NO aparece '=== PREVIOUS ATTEMPT — WHY IT FAILED ==='.
OPCION B — Skip (continuar sin la tarea):
cargo run --bin dag_engine -- run tests/graphs/advanced/critic_feedback_cleanup_test.json \
--session-id <ID> --answer 'skip'
VERIFICAR: tarea marcada como '[SKIPPED by user after max retries]', DAG termina con FINISHED.
El feedback_key fue limpiado.
OPCION C — Cancel (cancelar definitivamente):
cargo run --bin dag_engine -- run tests/graphs/advanced/critic_feedback_cleanup_test.json \
--session-id <ID> --answer 'cancel'
VERIFICAR: tarea marcada como '[CANCELLED by user]', DAG termina con FINISHED.
El feedback_key fue limpiado.
OPCION D — Retry con instrucciones del usuario:
cargo run --bin dag_engine -- run tests/graphs/advanced/critic_feedback_cleanup_test.json \
--session-id <ID> --answer 'retry Include specific Q1 2024 opening price of $248 and the annual drop of -50%'
VERIFICAR: El agente recibe '=== USER CLARIFICATION ===' con las instrucciones del usuario.
El '=== PREVIOUS ATTEMPT — WHY IT FAILED ===' del critic previo NO aparece (fue limpiado al hacer retry).
El contador de reintentos se resetea.
Usar --include-extra-info para ver el state completo y verificar la limpieza del feedback_key.

config.prompt: Analyze the performance of Tesla stock in 2024.

planner.system_message: Create exactly ONE task: assign 'Analyze Tesla stock performance in 2024' to analyst_agent in phase 1. Output ONLY a JSON array with one item.

analyst_agent.description: Analyzes financial stock performance for a given company and year.

config.system_message: You are a financial analyst. Analyze Tesla stock in 2024. Write 3-4 sentences. Focus on qualitative trends, not specific numbers.

critic.system_message:
You are a strict financial data critic. Accept a stock analysis ONLY if it contains ALL of:
1. At least one specific price figure (e.g. "$200", "$180.50")
2. At least one percentage change (e.g. "+15%", "-8.3%")
3. The word "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", or "Q4" referencing a specific quarter

For each missing element, list it explicitly in feedback. For example:
- "Missing: specific price figure. Include the stock price at start or end of 2024."
- "Missing: percentage change. Include the annual gain or loss as a percentage."
- "Missing: quarterly reference. Mention at least one specific quarter."

Set task_ok=false, suspend=false when anything is missing.
Set task_ok=true, feedback="" only when ALL three are present.

phase_reactor.system_message: Review completed phase results. If all tasks are done (including SKIPPED/CANCELLED ones), set requires_replanning=false.

final_reactor.system_message: Summarize the final stock analysis outcome in 2-3 lines. Note any tasks that were skipped or cancelled.
